lines: Cyrus Jamshed Guzder, an Investor Selling Shareholder, sells up to 132,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Up to ₹17.85 crore in proceeds has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026, 249 days ago.
Gain is up to ₹13.36 crore before offer expenses and taxes, and no shares are retained, so no further upside remains.
